svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Kubernetes web workload
svg.desc: Kubernetes web workload. 11 components in 2 groups. Connections: Users to Ingress (HTTPS); Ingress to Service; Service to Pods; HPA to Deployment; Deployment to ReplicaSet; ReplicaSet to Pods; Pods to ConfigMap; Pods to Secret; Pods to PVC; PVC to PersistentVolume.

text.tspan: Traffic reaches the pods through an Ingress and a Service; a Deployment owns them, an HPA scales them, a ConfigMap, Secret and PVC feed them
